name: Air separation unit (ASU)
description: Cryogenic distillation plant that separates air into nitrogen, oxygen and argon. In ammonia plants the ASU supplies the nitrogen feed at high purity; in gasification, oxyfuel and CCS plants it supplies oxygen.
applications: oxygen for gasification, oxyfuel combustion and partial oxidation

specifications.basis: cryogenic distillation delivers almost pure nitrogen, typically below 1 ppm oxygen
NETL design case for a 1.3 Mt/yr ammonia ATR plant
conventional ASU at >99.5% oxygen purity, per tonne of contained oxygen; 20 C ambient, 15 C cooling water, 60% RH, sea level (oxygen basis, not ammonia nitrogen basis)

source.note: Linde AG, 1st Oxyfuel Combustion Conference, Cottbus, 2009
